visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with neatly styled black hair, wearing a black and white vertical striped shirt, holds up a light peach-colored makeup box and smiles at the camera. He stands in front of a large, high-contrast monochrome poster of a smiling face with thick glasses. (2) The camera transitions to a retail display featuring various makeup palettes like the Artist Eye Palette. Multiple product boxes and open testers are neatly arranged on sleek, light-colored shelves. (3) Outside the Jung Saem Mool flagship store in Seongsu, the man stands under a bright blue sky, gesturing expansively towards the modern glass building and the brand's prominent white signage. (4) Inside the store, the scene shows a minimalist, high-end environment with curved, pastel yellow display tables holding rows of cushions and eyeshadows. The lighting is bright and even studio-style. (5) Close-up views focus on individual eyeshadow palettes: Soft Nude, Red Brown, and Orange Brown. The man's arm is used to showcase swatches of these shades, highlighting the shimmer and matte textures against his skin. (6) Further products are featured, including Masterclass makeup brushes and Skin Nuder Foundation. A hand applies a drop of foundation to the skin, blending it to demonstrate its dewy finish. (7) In the final phase, the man is back outside the store, holding a black shopping bag with white brand lettering. He points toward the building with a cheerful expression, concluding his shopping tour.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic male narrator begins speaking in Mandarin with a clear, bright tone, expressing high arousal and positive valence. Background music is an upbeat acoustic guitar and light percussion track at roughly 120 BPM. (2) The voice maintains a high speech rate as he introduces the retail environment. Acoustic texture remains very clean with high signal-to-noise ratio, suggesting high-quality audio capture. (3) A brief shift in ambient air pressure suggests an outdoor transition, though speech clarity remains high. The BGM maintains a consistent, joyful major-mode progression. (4) As the narration dives into product details, the pitch variability increases to emphasize brand features. The interplay between the rhythmic guitar strumming and the articulate voice creates a highly dynamic auditory experience. (5) Small incidental rustling of product packaging is briefly audible under the main vocal track. The session concludes with a strong, rising intonation as a final recommendation is made.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle and beauty vlog designed to promote the 'JUNG SAEM MOOL' flagship store in Seoul. The creator uses an enthusiastic and personal approach to review specific makeup products—eyeshadows, brushes, and foundation—demonstrating their application and quality to encourage fans and makeup enthusiasts to visit the store and purchase the items.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct recommendation of the brand and store, showcasing specific products and their benefits while holding a brand shopping bag.
